sections.heading: Identity
paragraphs: Access rights are reviewed each calendar quarter. Leaver accounts must be disabled within one business day. A reviewer cannot approve their own entitlement. JIT elevation is permitted when each grant expires after 60 minutes and is logged.

sections.heading: Network
paragraphs: Management SSH for production must be reachable only from corporate VPN 10.20.0.0/16. Public HTTPS through the load balancer is permitted. Firewall export is reconciled monthly.

sections.heading: Cryptography
paragraphs: Customer databases and snapshots use AES-256 encryption with service-managed KMS keys rotated annually; the application edge enforces TLS 1.3. September configuration sampling checked 12 of 12 production accounts.

sections.heading: Governance
paragraphs: Policy exception reviews are due quarterly. The September review log records completion on 2026-09-20 by the incoming compliance manager, whose appointment took effect on 2026-10-03. No delegated reviewer is recorded.
